rpguiinfo: You can use these commands in chat: /rp Displays the number of remaining respawns .rpguireset Resets the window position .rpguioff Disables the `Respawn` window .rpguion Enables the `Respawn` window again Spawn point: When a player starts a game or joins a server, their character appears at the world's initial spawn point. Each time the character dies, they respawn near that initial point until they obtain a temporal gear. Using this item allows the player to choose any location as their spawn point. Each player must obtain their own temporal gear, and resetting one player's spawn point does not affect another player's spawn point. A player can redefine their spawn point at any time by using another temporal gear. Resetting: Place the temporal gear in an empty hotbar slot. Hold it in your right hand, aim at a block, and hold the right mouse button to activate it. During activation, your screen will shake quite dramatically. Once the temporal gear has been consumed, the shaking will stop and your spawn point will have been reset.
